bullets.title: MSFT: Azure accelerates to 48% YoY, guides 49-50% next quarter; PT raised to $650-$700
bullets.body: Microsoft delivered a strong F1Q27 beat with revenue +19% YoY to $92.3B, non-GAAP EPS $4.89 vs consensus $4.71. Azure grew 48% (vs 43% prior), guided 49-50% cc next quarter with demand exceeding supply; Copilot daily users +50% QoQ. Piper raised PT to $650 (OW), Goldman to $700, DADCO Buy at $650; MSFT also filed a ~$25B 10-part IG bond offering, first since 2017.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Search misses badly (-2% vs consensus), stock -10-11% on negative FCF and capex spiral
bullets.body: Alphabet Q3 Search revenue grew only 12% vs consensus 14-15%, with total revenue $127.6B missing $128.2B expected; Q3 EBIT $40.1B well below expectations. GCP grew 103% YoY but quarterly capex hit $51.4B, producing -$9.1B FCF. FY26 capex guide maintained at $195-205B with FY27 expected to rise significantly. Piper cut PT to $345 from $400; Citi cut target to $375; Citizens downgraded to Market Perform. DA Davidson rates Neutral with headline 'Is This the Quarter We Feared?'

bullets.title: NOW: Q3 beat but cRPO deceleration and Q4 guide disappoint; stock -18% AH
bullets.body: ServiceNow F3Q revenue $4.11B slightly beat but cRPO +20.3% only 70bps above consensus; Q4 cRPO guide of +18.5% cc well below the +20% Street expectation, driving sharp PT cuts. AI ACV target raised to $1.7B (+65% YoY) and management expects stronger AI-driven acceleration in 2027, but near-term optics are poor. Stock -18.4% AH with NOW viewed as running too hot into the print.

bullets.title: MRVL/LITE: Bloomberg reports Marvell near deal to acquire Lumentum in ~$90B+ megadeal
bullets.body: Bloomberg reports Marvell in advanced talks to acquire Lumentum (LITE), potentially one of the 10 largest tech deals ever. LITE up ~7-10% on deal speculation; MRVL -10.9%. Strategic rationale is vertical integration of optical DSPs with LITE's lasers/photonics for AI networking, but risks include NVDA's long-term purchase commitment with LITE, DSP customer conflicts, capital-intensive manufacturing, and massive equity dilution (MRVL has only $3.9B cash vs LITE's ~$83B market cap). Morgan Stanley rates MRVL Equal-weight citing peak cyclical deal risk; Wolfe questions deal necessity given MRVL's existing FY31 $70-90B revenue guidance.

bullets.title: LITE: Citi Buy, $1,400 PT; OCS sales model 46% above guidance on AI strength ahead of earnings
bullets.body: Citi models LITE Sep-Q revenue/EPS +2%/+2% vs guidance, and +7%/+8% for Dec-Q vs Street. OCS bottom-up estimate of $584M in 2H CY2026 is 46% above $400M guidance and 17% above prior Citi estimate; laser supply remains constrained. $1,400 PT based on 35x FY2028E EPS of ~$41.

bullets.title: ORCL: Investor Day +11%; FCF inflection path eases AI capex crowding-out fears
bullets.body: Oracle's Analyst Day impressed with updated LT revenue target of $225B+ (35% 5-year CAGR), 40%+ OPM target, and FCF expected to turn positive in 2H FY28 reaching $30B+ in FY29 vs consensus -$1B. Only ~$20B incremental capex needed through FY30 despite regional data center diversification. Citi raised estimates; stock +11% on confidence capex steps down from FY27-28 peaks.

bullets.title: PLTR: JPM initiates OW at $262 PT on AI leadership; Opco bullish ahead of Nov 2 earnings
bullets.body: JPMorgan initiates Palantir at Overweight with $262 PT, calling it a disruptive AI leader. Oppenheimer expects a beat-and-raise on November 2 with FY26 revenue growth potentially ~90% YoY; AI agent consumption up 13x YTD shows monetization traction. Ontology platform cited as key competitive differentiator.

bullets.title: TENB: CCB accelerates, DBNER improves, but new logos remain weak; PT $44 at ~15.5x EV/FCF
bullets.body: Tenable CCB accelerated 1pt QoQ to +9% YoY with Q4 guidance pointing to ~10% YoY possible; Tenable One now 59% of new business. DBNER improved to 107% (+1pt QoQ second straight quarter). Weakness: new logo adds -32% YTD. DADCO rates with $44 PT at 15x CY27 FCF implying high-single-digit to 10% growth into 2027.

bullets.title: VRT: Beat/raise with organic orders +100%+ YoY; Buy-rated at $313-$345 PT
bullets.body: Vertiv posted a significant earnings beat and raised FY26 guidance; organic orders grew more than 100% YoY. Goldman raises PT to $313, Roth raises to $345. FY27 revenue now expected at $19.6B with EPS $10.10 (up from $18.1B/$9.17 prior). Datacenter AI infrastructure demand remains robust.

bullets.title: ANET: Q3 expected ~$3.45B (+49% YoY); focus shifts to 2027 guidance and scale-up TAM update
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight at $220 PT on Arista; Q3 beat largely anticipated, with deferred revenue balance of ~$6.9B the primary uncertainty. Purchase commitments rose to ~$9.7B from ~$3.6B three quarters ago. No Analyst Day this year but potential TAM update on scale-up networking (Etherlink SU-144) is the key upcoming catalyst. Customer diversification to Google, Oracle, and Amazon beyond Meta/Microsoft is the medium-term driver.

bullets.title: CVNA: 3Q retail sales +39% YoY, elevated to Top Pick at Morgan Stanley; Citi reiterates Buy $90
bullets.body: Carvana 3Q retail sales reaccelerated to +39% YoY (~217K units, ~5% above consensus); available inventory +30% to ~87K units with supply the key growth constraint, not demand. Retail GAAP GPU +3% YoY despite fuel/rate headwinds. Morgan Stanley elevated CVNA to Top Pick on earnings algorithm durability; Citi reiterates Buy at $90 PT.

bullets.title: MU: Samsung earnings validate tight memory supply into CY28; HBM pricing set to rise
bullets.body: Samsung expects demand to exceed industry supply for several years, targeting 60-70% LTA coverage. CY27 capex focused on clean rooms with no meaningful bit growth in CY28; DRAM prices rose ~20% and NAND high-teens in Q3. Samsung ramping HBM4E in CY27 after strong HBM4 ramp in 2H26; Wolfe sees tightening supply benefiting Micron. Citi separately flags DRAM/HBM supply constrained through 2027-2028 with memory estimate revisions turning positive while SPE revisions slide.

bullets.title: EQIX: Model updated post-earnings; accelerating 2027 revenue growth expected; PT raised to $1,320
bullets.body: Citi raised estimates and PT to $1,320 on Equinix after solid Q3 results, expecting recurring revenue growth with upward bias into 2027. Citi conducting post-earnings model update following management callbacks.

bullets.title: TMUS: Q3 beat on EBITDA/FCF/postpaid adds; MS cuts PT to $196 (OW maintained) on churn risk
bullets.body: T-Mobile Q3 beat on core AEBITDA, service revenue, EPS, FCF, and postpaid net account adds (+274K vs +250K consensus); raised FY26 ARPA growth guide to +3.5% and core AEBITDA/FCF midpoints. However, churn rose to 1.09% (+12bps YoY) on pricing actions. Morgan Stanley maintains OW but cuts PT from $230 to $196, citing SPCX competitive risk and tightest peer multiple in 5+ years. Stock +3.4-3.7% premarket.

bullets.title: FSLR: Compelling entry at ~5x 2027E EBITDA; Q3 bookings expected well above 1-2GW run rate
bullets.body: Roth sees First Solar as a buyer opportunity ahead of Q3 earnings (reports today AH, consensus EPS $4.67). Q3 bookings expected well above 1-2GW range with pricing ~2c/W higher than Q2. FSLR's integrated cost structure (mid-20s c/W vs domestic peers ~40c/W) is a competitive moat despite ~40GW warehoused module inventory industry-wide.

bullets.title: DASH/CART: DoorDash acquiring Instacart for ~$17B ($65/share); expected to close end-2027 or H1 2028
bullets.body: GS TMT and Jefferies confirm DoorDash is acquiring Instacart for $65/share (~$17B equity value), with closing expected end-2027 or H1 2028. CART +3.4% post-close on deal confirmation.

bullets.title: AMZN: UBS raises PT to $348; AWS margins expected low-40s in Q3, targeting 46% in 2027 vs 38% consensus
bullets.body: UBS raises AMZN PT from $318 to $348 ahead of tonight's earnings (consensus EPS $1.97, revenue $202.22B). AWS operating margin forecast at 46% in 2027 vs 38% consensus, with organic growth guided 11-12%. AWS remains the key focus vs buy-side estimates.

bullets.title: AAPL: Goldman maintains Buy on A20 Pro/M6 cycle including first touchscreen MacBook Pro
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs maintains Buy on Apple, citing new A20 Pro chip and M6 devices including the first touchscreen MacBook Pro as near-term catalysts. AAPL reports Monday November 2 (consensus EPS $1.99, revenue $113.39B). Citi notes AAPL spending $25B on flash storage in 2026 vs $6B in 2025.

bullets.title: TKO: WWE partnership revenues accelerating in 2H26; attractive at <20x '28 FCF at ~$9/share
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley maintains Overweight on TKO; WWE partnership revenues accelerating in 2H26 with the stock attractive at less than 20x FY28 FCF (~$9/share). Q3 estimate trimmed ~$40M. MS also raises FWONK (OW, Top Pick) on F1 contracted revenue resilience and ~33% discount to peer aggregate.

bullets.title: FOMC hold with hawkish tilt; December hike ~85% priced; two dissenters called for immediate hike
bullets.body: Fed held rates at 3.75-4.0% with hawkish statement on inflation keeping a December hike live at ~85% priced. Two dissenters called for an immediate hike. Futures dialing back the third move for next year. US 10-year yield down 4bps to 4.99%.
